name: Tissue Box
instruction: Could you design a tissue box for me? I want it to be rectangular with a slot on the top to pull tissues from. Make sure it can hold a standard size tissue pack.

Shape accuracy: The object is a rectangular tissue box.
The box has a slot on the top for tissue extraction.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The slot is proportionate to the box.
Texture and surface detail: The material of the box should be sturdy enough to support the tissues.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The slot is positioned correctly on the top for easy access to tissues.
The dimensions of the box are proportionate to accommodate a standard tissue pack.
Object distance and contact: The slot does not interfere with the structural integrity of the box.
The base of the box is stable and supports the weight of the tissue pack.

Instruction execution accuracy: The design accurately reflects the request for a rectangular shape.
The inclusion of a top slot is correctly implemented.
The box is designed to hold a standard size tissue pack without issues.
